$schema_comment: Catalog of integrations the user can self-activate. Frontend renders one card per entry. fields[].optional skips the required-check; mcp.envMap maps catalog field names to env-var name the MCP code reads; mcp.inheritEnv lists platform env vars (e.g. GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID) to copy from process.env at spawn time. mcp.args supports {appsDir} placeholder so the same catalog works locally and in /opt/ide. mcp.allowedHosts lists every outbound hostname the integration needs at runtime — egress.js writes the active union to /srv/<ide>/egress/allowed-hosts.txt and the host-side egress-allowlist.sh resolves these to ipset entries; values wrapped in {{FIELD}} are substituted from the active store per-tenant (e.g. {{SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN}}, {{EMAIL_HOSTS_RESOLVED}}).

fields.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
fields.label: Bot token
fields.helper: Format: <bot_id>:<35-char-secret>. Issued by @BotFather.

fields.name: TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID
fields.label: Admin chat ID
fields.helper: Your Telegram numeric user ID. Send /start to @userinfobot to see it.

steps.title: Create the bot with @BotFather
steps.body:
On Telegram, open [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) and send `/newbot`.

- Display name: **{{botDisplayName}}**
- Username: must end with `bot` and be unique, e.g. `{{botName}}_bot`

BotFather replies with a token like `1234567890:AAE...` — paste it as the **Bot token**.

steps.title: Set a profile picture (optional)
steps.body: Download one of these and set it via @BotFather → menu → set bot's photo.

steps.title: Get your admin chat ID
steps.body: Open [@userinfobot](https://t.me/userinfobot) on Telegram and send `/start`. It replies with your numeric ID — paste it as **Admin chat ID**.

steps.title: Add teammates (optional)
steps.body: Each extra person sends `/start` to @userinfobot to get their ID. Paste them comma-separated in **Additional allowed IDs**.

integrations.label: Shopify
integrations.description: Orders, products, inventory and customers; draft orders, new products and fulfilments from chat.

fields.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
fields.label: Store domain
fields.helper: The .myshopify.com domain, not your public one.

fields.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Client ID
fields.placeholder: Client ID from Shopify Dev Dashboard
fields.helper: Settings → Credentials in your Shopify Dev Dashboard app.

fields.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helper: Starts with "shpss_". Same Settings → Credentials page.

fields.name: SHOPIFY_APP_NAME
fields.label: App name (optional)
fields.helper: Must match the app name in Shopify Dev Dashboard. Defaults to "shopify-mcp" if empty.

steps.title: Create a Shopify dev app
steps.body: Open [dev.shopify.com](https://dev.shopify.com), select your store and click **Create app**.

steps.title: Add Admin API scopes
steps.body:
App → **Configuration** → **Admin API access scopes**. Tick:

- `read/write_customers`
- `read/write_inventory`
- `read/write_orders`
- `read/write_products`
- `read_locations`
- `read/write_fulfillments`
- `read/write_draft_orders`
- `write_discounts`
- `read/write_publications`

Save, then click **Install app**.

steps.title: Find your .myshopify.com domain
steps.body: Your Shopify Admin URL is `admin.shopify.com/store/`**`<handle>`**`/...` — the store domain is `<handle>.myshopify.com` (a custom domain does not work for the API).

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Secret
steps.body: App → **Settings** → **Credentials** → copy **Client ID** and **Client Secret** (not the `shpat_` token).

integrations.label: Meta Ads
integrations.description: Facebook and Instagram ads: campaigns, ad sets, audiences and insights for pages and accounts.

fields.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
fields.label: System User token
fields.helper: Non-expiring token from Business Manager → System Users → Generate New Token.

fields.name: META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
fields.label: Ad account ID
fields.helper: Must include the "act_" prefix.

fields.name: META_PAGE_ID
fields.label: Facebook Page ID (optional)
fields.helper: Only needed for page insights / posting tools.

fields.name: META_INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID
fields.label: Instagram account ID (optional)
fields.helper: Only needed for Instagram insights and media tools.

fields.name: META_BUSINESS_ID
fields.label: Business Manager ID (optional)
fields.helper: Only needed for Business Portfolio tools (users, pixels, catalogs).

steps.title: Create a Meta App
steps.body: Go to [developers.facebook.com](https://developers.facebook.com) → **My Apps** → **Create App** → **Business** type. Development mode is enough for accounts you own.

steps.title: Add a System User
steps.body: Open [business.facebook.com](https://business.facebook.com) → **Business Settings** → **Users** → **System Users** → **Add** (role **Admin**). Click **Add Assets** → grant **Full Control** on the Ad Account, Facebook Page and Instagram account.

steps.title: Generate the access token
steps.body:
Click the system user → **Generate New Token** → select your app. Tick:

- `ads_management`
- `ads_read`
- `read_insights`
- `business_management`
- `catalog_management`
- `pages_read_engagement`
- `instagram_basic`
- `instagram_manage_insights`

Click **Generate** and copy the token.

steps.title: Find the IDs
steps.body:
All under **Business Settings**:

- **Ad account ID** → Ad Accounts → the account → copy with the `act_` prefix
- **Page ID** → Facebook Page → **About** → bottom
- **Instagram ID** → Instagram Accounts → the account → ID
- **Business ID** → Business Info

fields.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
fields.label: Developer token
fields.helper: From ads.google.com/aw/apicenter; needs a Manager (MCC) account.

fields.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
fields.label: Customer ID
fields.helper: Account number without dashes.

fields.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
fields.label: OAuth refresh token (optional, for write tools)
fields.helper: Only for writes; made once through the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Get a Developer Token
steps.body: Open [ads.google.com/aw/apicenter](https://ads.google.com/aw/apicenter) and copy the **Developer Token**. This needs a **Manager (MCC) account**; a new token starts in Test status — apply for **Basic Access** on the same page for live data.

steps.title: Enable the Google Ads API
steps.body: Open [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com) → **APIs & Services** → **Enable APIs** → **Google Ads API** → **Enable**. Use the Cloud project of your platform OAuth so the Client ID and Secret are reused.

steps.title: Find your Customer ID
steps.body: [ads.google.com](https://ads.google.com) → top right of the dashboard. Strip the dashes: `123-456-7890` becomes `1234567890`.

steps.title: Refresh token (writes only)
steps.body: Reads and Keyword Planner work without it. For writes, run the one-time Node script from **docs/INTEGRATIONS.md → Google Ads → Step 3** and paste the token it prints.

integrations.description: Traffic, events, conversions and user behaviour from Google Analytics, answered in plain words.

fields.name: GA4_PROPERTY_ID
fields.label: Property ID
fields.helper: Plain number from Admin → Property Settings. NOT the Measurement ID (G-XXXX).

fields.name: GA4_CREDENTIALS_JSON_CONTENT
fields.label: Service account JSON
fields.helper: Paste the full contents of the JSON key downloaded from Google Cloud.

steps.title: Find your Property ID
steps.body: [analytics.google.com](https://analytics.google.com) → **Admin** → **Property Settings** → copy **Property ID** — a plain number, not the `G-XXXXXXXX` Measurement ID.

steps.title: Create a service account
steps.body: [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com) → **IAM & Admin** → **Service Accounts** → **Create Service Account**. No roles needed.

steps.title: Download the JSON key
steps.body: The service account → **Keys** → **Add Key** → **Create new key** → **JSON** → **Create**. Open the downloaded file and paste its entire contents.

steps.title: Grant the service account access in GA4
steps.body: [analytics.google.com](https://analytics.google.com) → **Admin** → **Account Access Management** → **+** → **Add** the `client_email` from the JSON with the **Viewer** role.

fields.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
fields.label: Fine-grained PAT
fields.helper: Pick the repositories the bot may see and the permissions it needs.

fields.name: GITHUB_TOOLSETS
fields.label: Capabilities
fields.helper: Which groups of GitHub tools the bot gets.

fields.name: GITHUB_ALLOW_WRITE
fields.label: Allow bot to modify repos
fields.helper: Read only strips the write tools; a read-only token blocks writes anyway.

steps.title: Generate a fine-grained PAT
steps.body:
Open [github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new).

- **Repository access**: the repositories the bot should see
- **Repository permissions**: **Contents**, **Issues** and **Pull requests** — Read, or Read and write if the bot may change things; **Metadata**: Read

Click **Generate token** and copy it.

steps.title: Paste the token
steps.body: Paste the token. Leave **Capabilities** on the preset unless you need Actions or code security.

steps.title: Default boards (optional)

```
acme:https://trello.com/b/BFqnhhsY/acme,personal:https://trello.com/b/Other/me
```

fields.name: GDOCS_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: OAuth Client ID
fields.helper: From your own Google Cloud OAuth client (Web application type).

fields.name: GDOCS_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
fields.helper: Same OAuth client. Pair with the Client ID above.

fields.name: GDOCS_REFRESH_TOKEN
fields.label: Refresh token
fields.helper: Generate via OAuth Playground (instructions in step 3).

fields.name: GWORKSPACE_ALLOW_WRITE
fields.label: Allow bot to modify your Google Workspace data
fields.helper: Read and write lets the bot create, edit and delete for you.

steps.title: Create an OAuth client
steps.body: [console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com) → **APIs & Services** → **Credentials** → **Create OAuth client ID** → **Web application**, redirect URI `https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground`. Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.

steps.title: Enable the Workspace APIs
steps.body:
Same project → **APIs & Services** → **Library** → enable:

- **Google Docs API**
- **Google Drive API**
- **Google Sheets API**
- **Google Calendar API**
- **Google Slides API**
- **Google Tasks API**

steps.title: Generate the refresh token
steps.body:
Open [developers.google.com/oauthplayground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground) → **⚙** → **Use your own OAuth credentials** → paste the Client ID and Secret. In **Step 1** paste these scopes:

```
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/documents
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/presentations
https://www.googleapis.com/auth/tasks
```

**Authorize APIs** → sign in with the account the bot should see → **Allow** → **Exchange authorization code for tokens** → copy the `refresh_token`.
